faction.SheduThousand.desc:
Shedu’s Thousand is an army formed by former soldiers of the RealWare corporation. They betrayed their duty to the corporation for the sake of the eternal path of war. RealWare has always had a unique corporate culture. Although its goal, like any other corporation, was profit, for the security service combatants, honor, military valor and dignity were above all else. It's not just a market reputation, but an internal obsession to serve through endless training, brutal trials, and war for the sake of war itself. RealWare security specialists were trained to fight in any conditions and even infiltrated various PMCs under the guise of clones for the sake of extreme combat practice.

But even such fanatical discipline could not resist the call of destruction. Temptation came when RealWare troops were guarding the ancient ruins of Sinkhole Oasis, the resting place of the ruler of the Martian bramfatura Urparp, a legendary quasimorph and leader of the golden legions. Fighting the visions sent by his ancient empire, the soldiers succumbed to the promise of their new master: to give them a war they would find nowhere else. Urparp did not promise wealth or political power. He offered eternal war, a fight for the sake of fighting, a battle not subservient to mercenary goals, but only to the flames of destruction. Thus was born the army of Shedu’s Thousand.

A disciplined, well-equipped military force that uses a combination of corporate military technology and what Ur bramfatura gives them. The fighters of Shedu’s Thousand are enhanced by both technology and gavvakh. Each victory feeds their hunger for the next battle. Each battle is a step towards eternal conflict.

Unlike Tezctlan, Urparp does not wish to build a new Empire in the Solar System. He believes that the Shedu’s Thousand must prepare for the awakening of Gagtungr, the master of the Sun.

Headquarters: Sinkhole Oasis (Mars)

Army of Ur, the bramfatura of Mars.

faction.Sunlight.desc:
Sunlight Coven is one of the most unusual and mysterious corporations in the System. On the one hand, it is an ordinary religious organization. Religions were forced to institutionalize as corporations under the AnCap system. On the other hand, the Coven competes with Daydream Chem in pharmaceutical research. They also compete with AnCom because they own a small media empire. Based on the traditions of 20th and 21st century cults and reinforced by modern psychoactive technologies, the Coven offers its followers not just a religious experience, but “true enlightenment.” All employees of the corporation are required to participate in religious and ecstatic practices, since it is believed that enlightened people are much more effective than ordinary people.

The pharmaceutical arm of the Coven is a vital element in ensuring the commercial stability of the religious corporation. Sunlight Coven sells highly effective medical technologies, but does not openly trade in psychoactive substances. However, its drugs for the treatment of various types of addictions and support of rehabilitation are in great demand.

The Coven is also active in the media business. The corporation owns several film studios that produce documentaries about ancient and modern religious practices. The main consumers of this content are the employees of the Coven itself. However, multi-part videos about ancient Egyptian rituals and the orders of stonemasons or purple caps find viewers everywhere. This is a popular form of escapism for low-ranking corporate workers.

Sunlight Coven's educational programs are recognized as some of the best in the System in the fields of sociology and religious studies. The Coven provides educational services to those who wish to study the social structures and mechanisms that underlie modern cults and beliefs. Of course, only one of them has the power to rid you of prejudices—the cult of the Coven itself.

Sunlight Coven first appeared in the mid-20th century. As a corporation, it was formalized shortly after the Great Anarchist Revolution. A group of mystics and scientists took responsibility for the organization. Soon, the Coven began to seek ways to synthesize old occult knowledge with advanced pharmaceutical and neurotechnologies. The fall of the old states allowed the corporation to expand its influence, offering unique spiritual practices that go beyond traditional ideas about religious experience.

faction.Tezctlan.desc:
Tezctlan and his quasimorphs have learned how to remain in the physical world indefinitely. Tezctlan has proclaimed himself Emerald Emperor, and the Solar System as his future Emerald Empire. Tezctlan seeks to subjugate all of humanity, as well as other bramfaturas. At the end of 2199, he was able to access the SBN network and announce his intentions through open channels. The Hexarchy is doing its utmost to maintain the narrative that this was nothing more than an act by the Civil Resistance. We know that Tezctlan's abilities and his sudden emergence are linked to Fresco Corporation technology.

In the past we completed several missions for AnCom against Fresco. But it was our actions that led to the emergence or awakening of Tezctlan. However, we share this responsibility with Dr. Eipschwitz.

The history of Tezctlan is difficult to analyze precisely. This quasimorph either appeared or was reborn on Venus in late 2199. As far as we can tell, the latter is closer to the truth. Tezctlan was the highest hierarch of Gannix, but then either disappeared from the bramfatura or was plunged into a sleep-like state. This happened hundreds to thousands of years ago. The Fresco Corporation, a virtual monopoly on the surface of Venus, was attacked by other System corporations. Such a brazen takeover is possible only with the tacit approval of the Hexarchy. In a desperate attempt to save the corporation, its management allowed Dr. Eipschwitz, a scientist and radical, to use any necessary means. The awakening of Tezctlan did not help Fresco survive, but those who tried to appropriate its property on Venus suffered serious losses.

Tezctlan declared his kingdom of Gannix an Empire. And he proclaimed that the new Emerald Empire was an empire of two realms. Now he wants only one thing: to subjugate humanity. Apparently, Tezctlan needs us not only as servants or slaves, but also as a constant source of gavvakh, i.e. energy.

faction.Tianming.desc:
Tianming Corporation began as an expansive biotech-industrial complex. Its distinctiveness lies in a philosophy rooted deeply in the historical and cultural legacy of Southeast Asia. Since its founding, Tianming has embraced the doctrine of the Mandate of Heaven. This is a belief that corporations derive their right to exist from higher powers that govern the universe. Tianming asserts that the Mandate of Heaven is inseparable from the NCE, though the other hexarchies deliberately reject this claim.

Tianming is a master of extracting maximum efficiency from minimal resources. With limited access to critical assets, the corporation deploys outfitted stations and even entire asteroids into anarcho-capitalist zones. One of its most controversial methods involves cloning living tissue for immediate conversion into bio-reactors that generate electricity. It is far more efficient to process whole organisms rather than isolated tissue samples. Tianming insists that these highly efficient reactors serve the philosophy of the Great Symmetry, a worldview where life and death form a continuous cycle, each serving the greater good of humanity.

The corporation has near-total dominance in the Outer System. Its facilities harvest whatever resources are available and convert them into energy used to power engineering, military, industrial, and transport projects. Tianming is remarkably autonomous and resilient, capable of surviving political shifts and external threats with ease.

The corporation’s flagship initiative, One Belt One Road, is an ambitious push to colonize the Main Belt. Naturally, this puts it in constant friction with Dilthey and local pirate factions.

The Outer System is vast, volatile, and largely outside the reach of centralized control. Subduing it requires a force that is both disciplined and brutally efficient. Tianming’s answer is the Joint Security Service (JSS), a hybrid security force made up of elite professionals and conscripted pirates. Those who serve are granted amnesty and permanent employment within the corporation upon completion of duty. Public channels within the SBN suggest that JSS numbers may be significantly higher than what Tianming officially discloses. Under the Mandate of Heaven, all who resist the order are destined to vanish.

faction.UnchainedBelt.desc:
The Unchained Belt (UB) is not just a collective name for a group of public enemies. For many in the Solar System, it is a symbol of true freedom in space. Their spacecraft suddenly appear in the path of large corporate convoys, only to seize loot and disappear before anyone knows what happened.

The UB controls a variety of pirate organizations, from individual crews to the entire pirate city of Hargeisa on the asteroid of Interamnia. The UB supplies the pirates with resources and information, in exchange for a share of the spoils. Although there is an opinion from several corporate intelligence agencies that the UB cannot be separated from the pirates: they are themselves pirates. Any bandit group that decides to act independently immediately faces the wrath of the loyal UB crews.

Despite their criminal methods and extremely short lifespans, space pirates inspire outcasts across the Solar System. They have a philosophy: freedom for freedom’s sake. If the Unchained Belt has an ideology, it is born out of dissatisfaction with the false freedom of the AnCap system. For them, the Main Belt is a place that could be a space for free living, but instead has been turned into a resource base for the corporate machine. Unlike the Civil Resistance, the UB does not seek to restore the old world and its laws. They live by their own rules: the Pirate Code.

Each new raid is not simply an attack for resources. It is an act of defiance, a rebellion against the AnCap system that seeks to drive everyone into corporate cages. Each new raid adds another legend to their glory, and rumors of the greatest adventures in history fan the flames of interest and attract new people. The UB agents have infiltrated everywhere—from PMCs to the corporations themselves—and no one can be sure whether a colleague is working for the pirates. In a world where power belongs to those with more money and spacecraft, the Unchained Belt chooses to live by different rules: they create their own destiny in the Solar System.

Headquarters: Hargeisa (Interamnia)

Union of pirate crews.

faction.XiomaraMasks.desc:
Each bramfatura has its own complex hierarchy. Kings, dukes, barons, knights. The Feathered Masks are a new order of taltnoms*. They rebelled against Tezctlan and are slightly more sociable than other quasimorphs. There are reports that they are fighting for freedom against the tyranny of Tezctlan. There are analytical reports that Xiomara simply wants to bring Gannix back inside the borders of their bramfatura. In any case, their ultimate goal is the elimination of Tezctlan. To do this, they established themselves in physical reality, which automatically included them in a war between factions from across the entire System.

About 1,000 years ago, Tezctlan disappeared from Gannix, and it was Duchess Xiomara who took control of the Venusian bramfatura into her own hands.

*Taltnoms are quasimorphs of Gannix.
